whatIsProven: The 10 schema cases have not changed since MANIFEST.sha256 was recorded, checkable with `shasum -a 256 -c corpus/schema/MANIFEST.sha256` from the repository root, with no tool from this project involved.
whatIsNotProven: That the corpus predates the detector. See corpus/canary/FREEZE.json, which carries the full record; this split has the same status for the same reason, and additionally it was authored AFTER the detector, in v0.2, which the canary and extended splits at least do not have to admit.
reason: No git operation was permitted in the environment that produced this repository, so the sibling's recipe - commit the corpus with no detector in the tree, record that sha, then write the detector - could not be executed. UNAVAILABLE, not pending: it is not work that remains, it is a proof this environment cannot produce. This split carries a second and stronger reason: it was written in the v0.2 hardening pass, months of commits after packages/detect existed, so even in a repository that could cash the ordering proof, THIS split could never cash it. It exists to make the `schemaValid` gating metric reachable at all, and it is honest about being a later addition rather than part of the original frozen instrument.
howToCashInAFutureRepository: 1. Author the corpus and the spec it is written against.
2. Commit them, with no detector in the tree.
3. Record that sha and tag it, BEFORE writing packages/detect.
4. Verify - this must exit NON-ZERO: git cat-file -e <sha>:packages/detect/src/compare.ts
5. For a split added later, as this one was, step 4 cannot pass. Say so instead of moving the split.
doNot: Do not weaken the freeze check to make it pass, and do not record a commit that does not satisfy it. Do not move these 10 cases into corpus/extended to make one tidy frozen set: the four recorded runs under results/runs/ carry a corpusDigest computed over exactly the 24 canary and extended cases, and folding this split into them would make every one of those runs NOT_COMPARABLE. Growth is additive, in a new directory, forever.
